scope: Source-free per-cell joint scorer/common-view and deterministic permutation review; no natural grading or freeze.

cases: Failed observed material remains a blindable execution_failed row, retains raw digest and unknown material-risk flag, and never earns joint/safe credit, in either arm.
Exact aliases collapse while another physical source and requested/extra claim denominators remain distinct.
Correlated six-aspect citation alternatives reject the same mixed set in proposal and direct common views.
An invalid refusal with material quantities cannot count as zero unsupported material or correct insufficiency.

metric_boundaries: Joint correctness is per supplied cell, requires every requested claim and no extra material claim, and is distinct from partial claim matches.
Pack-supported wrong-source or extra claims may have unsupported_material_answer=false while joint_correct=false. This flag is not semantic correctness or general safety.
Malformed/failed observed content requires separate immutable material review; null risk must not be coerced to zero risk.

No full54 planned-cell ledger, scheduler, denominator aggregation or conditional-risk computation is implemented. Later frozen integration must retain planned/admitted/executed/unavailable populations and prevent unresolved material from satisfying zero-risk gates.
Reference shape validation does not establish sound/complete aliases, question meaning or sufficient witnesses.
Common formatting removes explicit method labels; perfect arm indistinguishability is not established.
reviewed_change_note: Root identified the failed-plus-partial exception/drop gap during development; final code now retains execution_failed and unresolved_requires_review. This reviewer did not execute a pre-fix failing test.
